label: FLUX.3 Image Klein (text to image, and edit from reference images)

capabilities._note: One graph, both jobs: ReferenceMultiLatent adds each reference image to both conditionings, and with none it is cut out and the graph is text to image (target.py). Up to 10 references (BFL's model card), a real negative prompt (cfg 3.5) and an ordinary KSampler. The base checkpoint: slower than flux3_klein_turbo (25 steps against 16, and the negative pass), the one for LoRAs trained on the base.

template._note: Sizes a series ref is generated at (as krea2's). A keyframe is generated at its shot's render size, scaled up (same aspect, multiples of size_multiple) to at least min_pixels, as flux2_klein_edit's. The output is the job's size (EmptyFlux2LatentImage), not the first reference's (the template's empty_latent); each reference is scaled to 1 MP by ReferenceMultiLatent, as the template does.

recipe._note: The prompt names each reference by its number ('image 1', 'image 2', ...; `ref_word`) and says what to take from it (targets/image/common.py reference_intro), up to max_refs.

binding._note: An API graph built from ComfyUI's image_flux3_klein_image_edit.json (workflow templates 0.11.85): UNETLoader, CLIPLoader type flux3, VAELoader, a positive and an empty negative CLIPTextEncode into ReferenceMultiLatent (resize, 1 MP), KSampler euler/simple. The template's bounding-box nodes, ImageCompare and its unconnected EmptyFlux2LatentImage are left out; the latent is an EmptyFlux2LatentImage at the job's size instead of the node's empty_latent. The text-to-image template's prompt upsampler (a 9B Qwen3.5 TextGenerate before the encoder) is left out: the prompts seriesmith writes are already full captions. H3SaveRefTake takes the place of SaveImage.

models._note: Name-based identification only: no header fingerprint is recorded for FLUX.3 Klein yet (targets/modelid.py RULES). The text encoder is the same Qwen3-VL 4B as Krea 2's (ComfyUI loads both as TEModel.QWEN3VL_4B), so Krea 2's fp8 file serves as well; the VAE is FLUX.2's.

presets._note: The edit template's settings: 25 steps, cfg 3.5, euler/simple (BFL's card says 50 for full quality). The negative is empty, as the template's.

downloads._note: BFL's ComfyUI repo, gated: accept its licence (FLUX Kommunity) on the page first and download with a Hugging Face token. The repo also has bf16 and nvfp4 (Blackwell) copies of the checkpoint; the templates name the int8 ones.
